parrafo_1.es: Newman BBQ Catering & Events es un equipo de cocina profesional en Lakeland que sirve BBQ en bodas, cenas corporativas, cumpleaños y eventos de caridad. Montan la mesa, sirven y lo recogen todo al terminar.
parrafo_1.en: Newman BBQ Catering & Events is a professional cook team in Lakeland serving BBQ at weddings, corporate dinners, birthdays and charity events. They set up the table, serve and clean everything up when it is done.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas destacan lo mismo una y otra vez: puntuales, fáciles de coordinar y comida que la gente sigue pidiendo año tras año, desde bodas hasta la cena anual de empresas locales.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews highlight the same thing again and again: punctual, easy to coordinate with, and food that people keep requesting year after year, from weddings to the annual dinner of local companies.

texto.es: Nos cuentas la fecha, el número de invitados y el tipo de evento.
texto.en: You tell us the date, the guest count and the type of event.

texto.es: Elegimos juntos entre costillas, pulled pork, pollo a la parrilla y los acompañantes.
texto.en: We pick together from ribs, pulled pork, grilled chicken and the sides.

texto.es: Llegamos con todo listo, montamos la mesa de buffet y servimos a tus invitados.
texto.en: We show up with everything ready, set up the buffet table and serve your guests.

texto.es: Al terminar el evento, recogemos la mesa y nos vamos: tu solo disfrutas la fiesta.
texto.en: When the event is over, we break down the table and head out, you just enjoy the party.

nota.es: Cada evento se cotiza según el número de invitados y el menú. Llama y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every event is quoted based on guest count and menu. Call us and we will walk you through the details, no strings attached.

texto.es: Costillas glaseadas a la parrilla, el plato que más mencionan nuestros clientes en sus reseñas.
texto.en: Grilled and glazed ribs, the dish our clients mention the most in their reviews.

texto.es: Cerdo desmenuzado lento, servido en sandwich o como plato principal del buffet.
texto.en: Slow-smoked shredded pork, served as a sandwich or as a main dish on the buffet.

texto.es: Pollo jugoso a la parrilla, una de las opciones favoritas para recepciones de boda.
texto.en: Juicy grilled chicken, one of the favorite options for wedding receptions.

texto.es: Jamón completo para Navidad y Año Nuevo, uno de los pedidos más elogiados en las reseñas.
texto.en: Whole holiday ham for Christmas and New Year, one of the most praised orders in the reviews.

pie.es: ¿Tienes un menú en mente? Escríbenos y lo armamos juntos para tu evento.
pie.en: Have a menu in mind? Message us and we will build it together for your event.

items.quote: Newman bbq catered my wedding reception with awesome food and service. They were on time, set up everything, food was great, and broke everything down.
Newman recently catered our FBA Annual Dinner. Everything was perfect. They are so easy to work with. The smiling staff set the tone, and 85 food enthusiasts had a great time.

Not only does Newman’s BBQ never let us down with their amazing food, they always work with people depending on the event. They consistently work events for fundraisers and always give back to the community.
